scope: Full4834-frame Dev, not Test. All registered rows and failures retained. Cached replay speed excludes pixel/encoder preparation and is not end-to-end FPS.
note: All six residual heads executed18 epochs. Seed0 new-IR head reaches50.933 but improvements do not survive all three seeds. Fixed RGB inheritance and equal-capacity RGB controls are retained. The common stopping rule requires extending all six to24; single-seed gains are not independent contribution proof.
